g.text: Oblique photograph: road C26 at Gamsberg Pass, Namibia (2014)
Photo: Olga Ernst, “C26 at Gamsberg Pass, Namibia (2014)”, Wikimedia
Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0. Resized; the answer version is annotated and
The unsealed road winds through the valley: across the
foreground, then along the lower part of the left-hand slope,
Steep, rocky slopes rise above it on both sides; the road keeps
to the lower, gentler parts instead of climbing straight over
The photograph cannot show the exact gradient, the building cost
or the full reason the road was placed here.
